name: Jammu & Kashmir
intro: Dal Lake's shikaras and houseboats, the Mughal gardens of Srinagar, Gulmarg's gondola and ski slopes, Sonamarg and Pahalgam, the Great Lakes trek, Vaishno Devi and Amarnath, Jammu's temples and palaces, and the Chenab rail bridge. Some Kashmir spots closed after the 2025 Pahalgam attack are reopening in phases, so check before you go.
